flags.name: Read warning
flags.action: Check read-error trends; isolate media and drive with approved procedures.

flags.name: Write warning
flags.action: Review write-error trends and media condition before the next job.

flags.name: Hard error
flags.action: Check flags 4, 5 and 6 to narrow the failure.

flags.name: Media
flags.action: Preserve readable data under your recovery procedure and retire faulty media.

flags.name: Read failure
flags.action: Investigate media and drive; preserve the original cartridge for recovery.

flags.name: Write failure
flags.action: Review the failed job and isolate the cartridge from the drive fault.

flags.name: Media life
flags.action: Schedule replacement of the cartridge and preserve required data.

flags.name: Not data grade
flags.action: Use media approved for the drive and the intended retention policy.

flags.name: Write protect
flags.action: Verify that cartridge protection matches the intended job; do not change it automatically.

flags.name: No removal
flags.action: Check the application's media-removal reservation before operator intervention.

flags.name: Cleaning media
flags.action: Confirm that the loaded cartridge is intended for cleaning.

flags.name: Unsupported format
flags.action: Check drive-generation and cartridge-format compatibility.

flags.name: Recoverable mechanical cartridge failure
flags.action: Follow the vendor's safe cartridge recovery procedure.

flags.name: Unrecoverable mechanical cartridge failure
flags.action: Stop using the cartridge and request qualified service.

flags.name: Memory chip in cartridge failure
flags.action: Review cartridge-memory errors and plan media replacement.

flags.name: Forced eject
flags.action: Check job completion and cartridge integrity after the forced removal.

flags.name: Read only format
flags.action: Use a drive and media combination that supports the intended operation.

flags.name: Tape directory corrupted on load
flags.action: Preserve the data and consult the application recovery procedure.

flags.name: Nearing media life
flags.action: Plan cartridge replacement before its service limit.

flags.name: Clean now
flags.action: Arrange an approved cleaning cycle with compatible cleaning media.

flags.name: Clean periodic
flags.action: Schedule cleaning according to the drive's maintenance instructions.

flags.name: Expired cleaning media
flags.action: Replace the cleaning cartridge with an unused or valid one.

flags.name: Invalid cleaning tape
flags.action: Select a cleaning cartridge approved for this drive.

flags.name: Retension requested
flags.action: Consult the drive vendor; this toolkit never repositions tape.

flags.name: Dual-port interface error
flags.action: Review both interface paths and transport error counters.

flags.name: Cooling fan failure
flags.action: Check cooling and request service for the failed fan.

flags.name: Power supply failure
flags.action: Check power redundancy and arrange service.

flags.name: Power consumption
flags.action: Check the drive's power requirements and supply condition.

flags.name: Drive maintenance
flags.action: Schedule the vendor's prescribed maintenance.

flags.name: Hardware A
flags.action: Preserve diagnostics and request hardware service.

flags.name: Hardware B
flags.action: Preserve diagnostics and consult the vendor's fault-isolation procedure.

flags.name: Interface
flags.action: Check interface cabling and transport errors using approved procedures.

flags.name: Eject media
flags.action: Consult the vendor's safe removal procedure; no eject command is issued here.

flags.name: Down-load fail
flags.action: Review the vendor's update procedure with support; this toolkit never updates firmware.

flags.name: Drive humidity
flags.action: Check the environment against the drive's humidity limits.

flags.name: Drive temperature
flags.action: Check airflow and ambient temperature against vendor limits.

flags.name: Drive voltage
flags.action: Have the power supply and voltage condition checked.

flags.name: Predictive failure
flags.action: Plan drive replacement and preserve diagnostics for service.

flags.name: Diagnostics required
flags.action: Arrange vendor-approved diagnostics after reviewing active workloads.

flags.name: Firmware failure
